chose: vitest takes maxWorkers 50% only when the suite starts below normal priority (os.getPriority() > 0), which is how a driven session's and the driver's verify suites start; at normal priority vitest's default of cores - 1 stands
over: A flat 50% cap; scaling the worker count by speedFactor or by the load average
because: In an interleaved A/B at n=2 on 2026-10-10, 50% took the unit suite from 60.2/71.1 s to 66.0/86.1 s on a quiet box, where nothing else competed for the cores — the operator's own runs. speedFactor stayed at 1.0 at load 24 while a suite ran, and the load average lags by a minute, so a back-to-back rerun would cap itself.
